title: Metric edge register row
description: A causal claim between two metrics, read as 'from_metric_id drives to_metric_id' or 'from_metric_id protects to_metric_id' (a guardrail). One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: from_metric_id, relation and to_metric_id (the edge itself; together they are the row's identity and must be unique) and evidence_status (the status of the causal claim; correlation alone supports inferred at most). evidence_ids and note may be empty for hypothesis and unknown edges.

to_metric_id.description: Metric that is driven or protected; never equal to from_metric_id.
